_comment: Consultancy = ZED_CONSULTANT (this host's database). Main = ZEDCS_V2_LIVE, read-only login, for features that read main's data (none of package A's endpoints need it yet).

Portal._comment: Served under the old IIS application /Consultancy (the Angular build uses baseHref /Consultancy/). PublicBaseUrl includes it, so mail links open this portal. StorageRoot must be the SAME folder as main's Portal:StorageRoot (certificates, reports and uploads are shared); set it to that absolute path on the server.
